units.name: 管理科学系 (Department of Management Science)
units.evidence: Current official management-school organisational inventory explicitly lists 管理科学系, literally Department of Management Science, among eight teaching departments. The 2026 school doctoral admissions allocation names the broader Management Science and Engineering formal degree subject; exact department administration of individual students not established.

sources.note: Full current School of Management organisation inventory, eight teaching departments and exact 管理科学系 title.

Official English school About page timed out twice; search preview used only as discovery, not source verification.

limitations: English parenthetical department name is literal translation of official Chinese 管理科学系; English school About page failed to open, so no claim that parenthetical is the institution's approved English rendering.
Formal doctoral subject is school-level; exact individual department host not verified.
